checks.scope: BRIEF-6.md Part B only: six families x four orientations x summer/winter = 48 files. Other out/ art is reference material and receives no verdict.
checks.previous_review: All 48 current SHA-256 hashes differ from critic-r6B-2-audit.json. Every bridge was reviewed afresh. Four changed former passes fail for the concrete winter defects listed below; no unchanged former pass was downgraded.
checks.individual_8x: Visually inspected every file in the six nearest-neighbour family sprites-8x sheets, over river blue. Opened additional river/dark/light fringe-8x strips for all four sci-fi winter orientations and fantasy/wuxia/jazz_age/wasteland d1 winter. All 48 have hard pixel clusters without blurred resampling or contour antialiasing; the only partial alpha is the required cast shadow. The identified pale interior snow flecks are failures, not accepted highlights.
checks.crossings_1x_4x: Visually inspected all 48 in all-crossings-1x and all six family crossings-4x sheets. Each bridge occupies the central 48px cell with its actual named road atlas on the banks. h/v use straight atlas tiles; diagonals include the neighbouring spill triangles rather than incomplete diagonal approaches. All deck ends meet the appropriate road edges/corners without a gap, width step or disruptive hue jump. Winter specimens retain a readable road centre.
checks.random_8x2_1x_4x: Visually inspected all-random-8x2-1x and all-random-8x2-4x: each of six labelled rows contains its own seeded eight-column, two-row one-cell sheet over river blue, with every orientation/season twice. No opaque cell matte, unintended grid or objectionable repeat appears. Repeated railing supports and plank rhythms are structural details. Random incompatible orientations are not treated as valid road joins; crossings are checked separately.
checks.operator_structure: Every orientation now has a distinct material-coloured rail/parapet band on both long sides, dark pixel outlines and short end supports. The straight vertical modern and sci-fi sprites are no longer plain strips. Rail bands read at cell scale; diagonal bands use deliberate stepped contours. The construction clears the operator structure requirement across all 48.
checks.operator_shadow_and_transparency: All 48 contain only alpha 0, 102 and 255; every partial-alpha pixel is pure black at 102/255 = 40%. Straight shadows form a three-pixel band below/right of the opaque structure; diagonal shadows form a stepped two/three-pixel band on the lower/right side. River remains visible beyond the structure and its shadow. Shadows read as elevation rather than an opaque water-colour backdrop.
checks.size_width_placement: All 48 are RGBA 48x48. h/v decks are centred, edge to edge; d1/d2 run between the specified opposite corners. The actual named road atlases have roughly 20-22px straight widths, as accepted by the previous review, rather than the approximate 12-14px in the prose brief. Current bridges preserve those real road joins. No widening/narrowing correction is requested.
checks.style: Verified all six required material identities in every orientation: timber post-and-rail, red lacquer/stone with a light crown, steel truss bracing, concrete/metal guard rails, dark metal/cyan edges, and patched scrap/planks. See family_observations.
checks.winter: All 24 winter sprites visibly differ from summer and retain their material identity, road centre and joins. Twenty have acceptable clean attached caps/edges. Fantasy d1 lacks a satisfactory southwest snow edge and has detached flecks; wuxia d1 and sci-fi h/d1 have residual deck snow speckle. Those four fail the explicit operator snow requirement.
checks.palette_light_and_approved_context: Compared against the six reference/road-<family>.png atlases and approved out/ markers, representative round-2 city/slums/industry/suburb/farmland tiles, paddies, and grass/plains bases and details in all four seasons. Viewed approved reference sheets at 1x, summer/winter matched-scale context at 1x/4x, and grass/plains calibration at 4x. The approved source files are unchanged since the previous review. Timber/stone/metal ramps, snow colours, outline weight and restrained material detail fit the approved assets. Upper/left highlights and lower/right shading are consistent; no reversed light or general palette clash was found.
checks.duplicates_and_noise: No exact RGBA duplicates among the 48. Family/orientation comparisons at 1x/4x/8x retain distinct materials and silhouettes. Rotation-related similarity is required for orientations, not a rejected variant. Outside the specifically failed snow flecks, no shipping-level muddy shapes, detached fringe/halo, unexplained surface noise or blank winter was found.
checks.bases_3x3: Not applicable: Part B has no seamless base textures. Supplemental approved summer/winter grass/plains 3x3 reference tilings were saved, but those out-of-scope assets receive no verdict.
checks.peaks_range_and_trees_forest: Not applicable: Part B has no peaks, ridges or trees. A lattice/range or forest placement composite would review another part and was not substituted for the required bridge crossing and random one-cell checks.
checks.other_specific_failures: Egg-crate peaks, Swiss-cheese craters, classical ruins, stamped cyberpunk city grounds, flat orange autumn and identical crowns concern files outside Part B. No such assets are included in this verdict.
checks.integrity: Full SHA-256 snapshots of every out/*.png before and after this review match. No file in art-drop/out/ was changed.

family_observations.fantasy: Timber planks, post-and-rail sides and dark joints read as a raised timber span in every orientation. The d1 winter southwest snow edge remains incomplete; see its failure.
family_observations.wuxia: Red lacquer side rails, stone end supports and a lighter mid-span crown establish an arched stone bridge. The warm stone remains compatible with the reference road. Only d1 winter retains unacceptable deck snow speckle.
family_observations.jazz_age: Cool steel side bands with visible diagonal/V bracing and warm end abutments establish the truss construction. Winter caps follow the sides while the road remains open. All eight pass.
family_observations.modern: Concrete shoulders, pale metal guard rails, dark outlines and end supports are now present in h/v/d1/d2. The smooth asphalt centre is appropriate pavement, and the lower/right shadow separates it from water. All eight pass.
family_observations.scifi: Both edges now have readable cyan strips on dark metal rail structures, including v and diagonals. Cyan is emissive and does not imply reversed sunlight. Winter h and d1 still contain isolated pale deck snow pixels; other six pass.
family_observations.wasteland: Grey patch plates, local rusty orange repairs, planks and patched side rails remain distinct from fantasy timber. Grey occupies enough of the deck to avoid a flat orange slab. Winter caps attach to the structure. All eight pass.
